profiles_hint.message: The official profiles of each slicer, updated automatically. Your own presets will be available with the BetterBridge helper app.

convert_not_saved.message: The converted file was not saved (download cancelled).

convert_tip.message: Open it as it is: your printer is already selected. If you pick the printer again in the slicer, choose “Transfer” to keep the model's values (“Discard” resets them to your printer's profile).

hero_title.message: Any model, ready for your printer.

hero_text.message: BetterBridge converts MakerWorld and Bambu Studio projects for your printer and slicer, keeping what the designer tuned.

hero_step3.message: Open it in your slicer and slice.

convert_drop_hint.message: or click to choose a file

printers_hint.message: The printers you convert for. Their profiles download by themselves.

conversion_hint.message: How BetterBridge decides which values to use.

basic_model_text.message: Supports, infill, speeds, ironing, purge tower… everything the designer changed is kept.

basic_printer_text.message: Bed, G-code, cooling, accelerations and calibration come from your printer's profile.

basic_slicer_text.message: Filaments are assigned in automatic mode, so the project opens and slices in OrcaSlicer, Flash Studio and others.
